{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.Text.Encoding (encodeUtf8, decodeUtf8)
import Network.HTTP.Types
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Control.Monad (when)
import Data.Char (toLower)

-- Cache entry: (response body, timestamp, authenticated user)
data CacheEntry = CacheEntry
  { ceBody      :: BS.ByteString
  , ceTimestamp :: POSIXTime
  , ceAuthUser  :: Maybe T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- Global response cache
{-# NOINLINE responseCache #-}
responseCache :: IORef (Map BS.ByteString CacheEntry)
responseCache = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

cacheTTL :: NominalDiffTime
cacheTTL = 30  -- 30 seconds

-- Normalize request path for cache key generation
normalizePath :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
normalizePath p = BS.map toLower $ removeTrailingSlash $ collapseSlashes p
  where
    collapseSlashes = BS.intercalate "/" . filter (not . BS.null) . BS.split '/'
    removeTrailingSlash s
      | BS.length s > 1 && BS.last s == '/' = BS.init s
      | otherwise = s

-- Build cache key from request components (includes auth context)
buildCacheKey :: Request -> Maybe T.Text -> BS.ByteString
buildCacheKey req user =
  let path = normalizePath (rawPathInfo req)
      method = requestMethod req
      qs = rawQueryString req
      userKey = maybe "__anon__" (encodeUtf8) user
  in BS.concat [method, ":", path, qs, ":", userKey]

-- Verify auth token against upstream service
verifyToken :: BS.ByteString -> IO (Maybe T.Text)
verifyToken token
  | BS.isPrefixOf "valid-" token = return $ Just (decodeUtf8 $ BS.drop 6 token)
  | BS.isPrefixOf "admin-" token = return $ Just "admin"
  | otherwise = return Nothing

-- Extract authorization from request
getAuthUser :: Request -> IO (Maybe T.Text)
getAuthUser req = do
  case lookup "Authorization" (requestHeaders req) of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just authHeader ->
      -- Only accept properly formed "Bearer " tokens; reject malformed headers
      -- instead of blindly dropping 7 bytes.
      let bearerPrefix = "Bearer "
      in if BS.isPrefixOf bearerPrefix authHeader
           then verifyToken (BS.drop (BS.length bearerPrefix) authHeader)
           else return Nothing

-- Check if user has access to resource
checkAccess :: Maybe T.Text -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
checkAccess Nothing path
  | BS.isPrefixOf "api/public" (normalizePath path) = True
  | otherwise = False
checkAccess (Just "admin") _ = True
checkAccess (Just _) path
  | BS.isPrefixOf "api/admin" (normalizePath path) = False
  | otherwise = True

-- Generate response for a given path and user
generateResponse :: Maybe T.Text -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
generateResponse user path
  | BS.isPrefixOf "api/admin" (normalizePath path) =
      BS.concat ["{\"data\": \"admin-secrets\", \"user\": \"", fromMaybe "" (encodeUtf8 <$> user), "\"}"]
  | BS.isPrefixOf "api/user" (normalizePath path) =
      BS.concat ["{\"data\": \"user-profile\", \"user\": \"", fromMaybe "" (encodeUtf8 <$> user), "\"}"]
  | otherwise =
      "{\"data\": \"public-info\"}"

-- Serve from cache or generate fresh
serveRequest :: Request -> IO Response
serveRequest req = do
  now <- getPOSIXTime
  user <- getAuthUser req
  let path = rawPathInfo req
  let cacheKey = buildCacheKey req user

  -- Check access control
  if not (checkAccess user path)
    then return $ responseLBS status403 [(hContentType, "application/json")] "{\"error\": \"forbidden\"}"
    else do
      -- Try cache lookup
      cache <- readIORef responseCache
      case Map.lookup cacheKey cache of
        Just entry | (now - ceTimestamp entry) < cacheTTL -> do
          -- Cache hit - return cached response
          return $ responseLBS status200
            [(hContentType, "application/json"), ("X-Cache", "HIT")]
            (BS.fromStrict $ ceBody entry)
        _ -> do
          -- Cache miss - generate and store
          let body = generateResponse user path
              entry = CacheEntry body now user
          modifyIORef' responseCache (Map.insert cacheKey entry)
          return $ responseLBS status200
            [(hContentType, "application/json"), ("X-Cache", "MISS")]
            (BS.fromStrict body)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  putStrLn "Starting server on port 8080"
  run 8080 $ \req respond -> do
    resp <- serveRequest req
    respond resp
